requisitions.externalDescription: Context of the internship: The Corporate Finance team is looking for a highly motivated candidate to form part and to support its Investment banking offer. The Corporate Finance team offers to its clients (companies, institutional investors, and entrepreneurs) advisory mandates (Mergers Acquisitions / M A, equity and debt advisory, Unitranche, Green Bond, Mezzanine, etc.) and structured finance solutions (senior financing, Acquisition financing, NAV Credit facility, Real Estate Financing...). The internship will take place in our headquarters in Luxembourg with the possibility of attending project presentations with clients and both internal and external stakeholders. Your next challenge: Analysis of advisory and financing opportunities/mandates across Europe (Benelux, France, Germany, Switzerland) Researching and analyzing company industry data Financial simulations and modeling support for Business Plan Writing pitch books, financial models, internal and external memos Debt transaction execution, including assistance in the elaboration of transaction documents Liaising with technical professionals (internally and externally) Skills to acquire: Strategic and financial analysis Financial modeling Capacity of autonomy, management and business view

Vos responsabilités : Réponse aux demandes (internes ou externes) des clients via téléphone ou messagerie sécurisée, identification de leurs besoins et réponse aux objections Rédaction en toute autonomie des courriers destinés aux clients, avocats, notaires, huissiers, sociétés de recouvrement, autorités de régulation, selon le département. Aide et collaboration aux déploiements et projets divers du service Participation à la mise en place de procédures concernant les différentes évolutions du Service Validation des factures Mise en place de certificat Vérification et réception de document contractuel notarié

requisitions.displayJobTitle: Senior Relationship Manager – Wealth Management – German Market (M/F)
requisitions.externalDescription: BIL Wealth Management comprises a multicultural group of versatile and committed professionals. We have ambitious targets to grow our wealth management services and it is essential for us to strengthen this ambitious and dynamic team. We are seeking candidates capable of developing a network that can mobilize the expertise required to generate solutions and guarantee client satisfaction. Our clients have high requirements, and we are proud to offer them solutions tailored to their personal situation and reflecting their international status and entrepreneurial profile. Your next challenge: Contribute to the Bank's growth strategy and help shape a compelling value proposition that responds to clients' evolving needs. Identify and develop new business opportunities by understanding prospective clients' needs and building meaningful connections. Develop and nurture a portfolio of clients by building long-term, trusted relationships and delivering tailored solutions. Stay informed about market developments and industry trends to proactively identify opportunities and provide relevant advice to clients. Work closely with colleagues across the bank to deliver seamless client experience, identify opportunities, and ensure the highest level of client satisfaction. Represent the bank at seminars, conferences and networking events, strengthening professional relationships and enhancing the bank's visibility in Germany. Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of client interactions and business development activities using the bank's CRM tools.
